data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year were GBP 1.645m. The gross prior-year development, derived from the published gross claims development table, shows an adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 1.259m attributable to the 2018 underwriting year. The report does not provide an explicit gross prior-year movement narrative; COVID-19 is cited as the primary cause of the overall 2020 loss but the identifiable prior-year reserve deterioration is reflected in the 2018 column of the claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: The loss for the financial year is mainly attributable to the SPA's exposure to losses arising from Covid19 within the contingency book of business.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' note found. Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims) - only the 2018 underwriting year qualified as 'prior' (the two most recent years 2019 and 2020 were excluded per methodology). exact_reserve_text is blank because the report does not contain a single-sentence verbatim description of the gross prior-year reserve movement. Post-balance-sheet note indicates an RITC into 2019 YOA which could affect future comparisons but not the 2018 triangle extraction.
